channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Joe Cronin | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Joe Cronin from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Joe Cronin
item.description:
Damian Lillard on his relationship with Joe Cronin:

“Toward the end, it was a lot of misunderstandings and miscommunications. When that happens, feelings are hurt. Joe and I never sat down and talked about that. We let it be and it sat out there. That was the mistake.”

Damian Lillard on Joe Cronin, Jul 22, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jrue Holiday on Joe Cronin
item.description:
Jrue Holiday on Blazers working with him on trade:

“Portland blessed me. Joe Cronin did a great job of communicating with me on how I wanted to proceed…Working with him was very easy, very seamless, and made all of this possible.”

Jrue Holiday on Joe Cronin, Oct 4, 2023. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: David Griffin on Joe Cronin
item.description:
He highlighted the need for Portland’s general manager, Joe Cronin, to ensure he doesn’t make a deal that could be perceived as unfavorable.

“The best thing that can happen to you when you’re in Joe Cronin’s situation – and I know because I lived this – is for the noise to be as loud and just the cacophony of voices that are involved to be as loud as possible, for people to make up as many things as possible,”

David Griffin on Joe Cronin, Jul 13, 2023. Source: TalkBasket.
